title_en: Divisions of Divine Unity and Their Interrelationship
description_en: Divisions of Divine Unity and Their Interrelationship, from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture explains the various categories of divine unity (tawhid) and how they relate to one another in Islamic theology.
